messages:
deploybot: created tag `v3.6.0-rc2` (commit `abc1234`) and published a short changelog.
deploybot: environment: canary -> eu-west1 (10% traffic). planned canary window: 2026-03-17 22:00-23:00 UTC. no DB migrations. CI: ✅ all checks passed. rollback candidate: `v3.6.0-rc1` (commit `def5678`).
maria: thanks — quick question: any config defaults changed that could affect latency?
lucy: yes, default `batch_size` bumped from 8 -> 16 in runtime config, could nudge tail latency. no schema/db changes though.
ash: @ashish tagging you for SRE guardrails — can we get a brief on rollback conditions?
ash: (note: using short name to reflect a real quick ping)
ash was a placeholder; replaced by ashish message below.
ashish: added. alerting hooks and SLOs set for this canary. automatic rollback if 5m error rate > 3% or p95 latency increases by >30%. manual rollback trigger: paging SRE on-call. fallback tag ready: `v3.6.0-rc1`.
maria: i'll pin the tag for dedicated clusters to avoid auto-upgrades. doing it now. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: pin applied for org:dedi-clusters by maria.
lucy: note for ops teams — there is a new per-route batching flag, default off for stable routes. recommend enabling on a small percentage post-canary.
maria: monitoring dashboards prepped, synthetic load running against canary. i'll watch the first 20 minutes closely. :eyes:
ashish: if we see CPU > 80% on infra nodes, we'll throttle canary to 5% and notify.
deploybot: canary rollout started at 2026-03-17T22:01:22Z (observability link: https://console.redwood/rollouts/2147123456). will post final status when complete. :rocket:
maria: ack. keeping slack channel open; will post status updates.
lucy: if rollback needed, use `kubectl rollout undo` on `service/rt-serving` and pin back to `v3.6.0-rc1` until root cause is fixed.
maria: pinned and monitoring. thanks all. :thumbsup:
